function_v0.doc:
Funded claim (L1-18): transfers the claimable balance from THIS
contract's own USDC (push-funded by the market's per-trade pot
transfers) to the referrer. If the balance cannot cover it, the
claim rejects with ClaimUnfunded and claimable is PRESERVED \xe2\x80\x94
an earned balance is never burned. Deliberately not pause-gated
(claims are exits).
function_v0.name: claim

function_v0.doc: Delete a referee's binding \xe2\x80\x94 future trades accrue nothing to the\nold referrer (self-referral cluster backstop).
function_v0.name: unbind

function_v0.doc: Swap the running WASM in place; codes, bindings and balances are\npreserved (mirrors the market/vault/router upgrade pattern).
function_v0.name: upgrade

function_v0.doc: Rotate the admin (R-11: the multisig migration path). Both current\nand new admin must sign \xe2\x80\x94 mirrors the vault/router pattern so a\nmistyped address can't brick the admin role.
function_v0.name: set_admin

function_v0.doc:
One-shot initialisation. The market contract address is the only
principal allowed to call `record_trade`; usdc_token is what the
funded `claim` pays out in (L1-18). Discount and share are in basis
points; min_code_volume is the 14-day rolling volume floor needed
to mint a code (cross-read from the market at create_code).
function_v0.name: initialize

function_v0.doc: Re-point at a redeployed market without losing code/referrer state.
function_v0.name: set_market

function_v0.doc: Pause the registry: record_trade becomes a (0,0) no-op, new codes\nand bindings reject. Claims stay open (exits are never gated).
function_v0.name: set_paused

function_v0.doc:
Mint a unique referral code for `referrer`. Each address can hold
at most one code; codes are case-sensitive 3..=16 char strings.

Volume gating (L1-18/R-3): the referrer's 14-day rolling volume is
cross-read from market.get_trader_volume and must be at least
MinCodeVolume. Fail-closed: an unreadable market counts as zero
volume (admin can set the floor to 0 to disable the gate).
function_v0.name: create_code

function_v0.doc: Revoke a code's referrer: record_trade accrues (0,0) for them and\nthe code takes no new bindings. Reversible via unrevoke.
function_v0.name: revoke_code

function_v0.doc: Public view: returns the referrer bound to `referee`, or None.
function_v0.name: get_referrer

function_v0.doc:
Market-only hook called whenever a fee-bearing event happens.
Returns (referee_discount, referrer_payout) \xe2\x80\x94 the market
applies the discount to the referee's fee and transfers the
payout to this contract, which then accrues against the
referrer's claimable balance.

For referees with no referrer this is a no-op returning (0, 0)
so the market doesn't have to branch.
function_v0.name: record_trade

function_v0.doc: Bind a referee to a referrer's code. Single-shot per referee:\nonce bound, the relationship is permanent. Self-referral is\nrejected. Increments the referrer's referred_count.
function_v0.name: set_referrer
